notes.title: International Basketball Manager
notes.content:
[h1] International Basketball Manager 2023 Major Update[/h1]

[b] The new update of International Basketball Manager 2023 [/b] is now available for PC/Mac and Android. In the coming days iOS users will also be able to enjoy it.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2098130/International_Basketball_Manager_23/

If you have already been enjoying International Basketball Manager 23 before this update, you are going to have this [b]new edition of the game for free. [/b] All you'll have to do is update the game in your Steam library and you're good to go. And if you are not yet part of the IBM23 family, [b] you will be able to get the game with a 20% discount during these first days. [/b]

IBM23 is back with [b] all the updated teams [/b] so that the best basketball Managers can build the squad to their liking to take their team to the top. All competitions have also been updated.

We hope you enjoy [b] International Basketball Manager 2023! [/b]

notes.title: IBM23 Update 1.2.0
notes.content:
Hello Managers,

We want to express again our gratitude for your support to IBM23 and inform you that we are still working on this project.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2098130/International_Basketball_Manager_23/

We have just released the second major update with theese changes:

[list]
[*] Updated database of players with some signings as of 26/01/2023.
[*] The market displays have been updated so that they do not have such an impact on memory.
[*] Corrected the blockage when consulting the mock draft by advancing several seasons.
[*] Fixed end-of-season bug in the update of the coaches market.
[*] Improved scouting for promising young talent. Depending on the quality of the scout, there will be a greater or lesser chance of finding a future star.
[*] Previously saved tactics can now be loaded correctly during a match.
[*] Fixed bugs in the Editor that did not allow modifying some players and teams.
[*] Corrected the bug in the renewals where the first refusal clause was not removed.
[*] Improvement in the application of the relegation clause. Now, when a team is relegated, its best players with this clause will leave the team.
[*] Players can no longer be recruited to an American Basketball College team if the player has had a professional contract in the past.
[*] Fixed the minutes allocation bug in friendly matches between American Basketball League teams.
[*] Corrected the extra-community places in leagues where teams from different countries participate.
[*] Fixed errors in the simulation of games such as the number of free throws after a technical foul.
[*] Added functionality on some screens such as the market button on the employees of your team.
[*] Optimization and improvements in the use of the Workshop.
[*] Visual bugs fixed on multiple screens.
[*] Other small bugs were fixed.
[/list]

In this update we have also added the possibility to import the top mods you have created with the PC Editor to any [b]mobile device[/b]. 

We remind you that we have the [b][url=https://discord.gg/BQpgwRXSdE]IBM23 Discord server[/url][/b] where you can comment on your experience with the game, make suggestions, help us if you find any undetected bugs and ask for technical support, among other things. There are many active Managers in this channel. 

Finally, we will be so delighted, if you like the game, if you write a positive review on our Steam page.

Thanks Managers!

notes.title: IBM23 Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
Hello Managers,

We would like to reiterate our thanks for your support. Many players have become managers of their favourite teams and they are sharing their experience.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2098130/International_Basketball_Manager_23/

After the Hotfix we uploaded the other day to fix the most urgent bugs, this new update 1.1.0, apart from fixing some minor bugs detected, also adds new features gathered from your comments and feedback these days. So these are the new features and bugs fixed.

[b]EDITOR[/b]
[list]
[*] Steam Workshop now active. We have activated the Steam workshop so that everyone can share their mods and also download those mods already created in an easier way. Now in the Editor you have the option to Export/Import mods locally or in the Steam workshop.
[*] Free agents players are now available for editing and photo editing.
[*] Open the editing of all fields of licensed players in the game.
[*] Open the editing of the coach, photo, president and flag fields of the licensed teams in the game.
[*] Fixed a bug with some players' photos that could not be changed because their name was duplicated in the database.
[*] Fixed a bug that did not allow to edit most of the jerseys of the US college competition.
[*] Small bugs fixed in the editor and other small improvements implemented, such as navigation with the tab key to move from one text field to another.
[/list]

[b]NEGOTIATIONS[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a player to always ask for more salary on the first counteroffer he had during a negotiation.
[*] Fixed a bug that told you that you didn't have enough money to sign a player in the last year of his contract. 
[*] You can now negotiate with all players found by the scout, even if the country has no competition.
[*] Added the player's conference in the Portfolio screen when you "Scout a player" in a US College League game.
[*] Added the College or U18 players you are recruiting to the "Status offers" screen. This way you will always have them there in case you want to resume a negotiation with them.
[*] Now if we scout a "Free agent" player, in Portfolio you will see the salary he would be willing to start negotiating with a team with your characteristics. However, the player may not even want to negotiate his signing and may tell you that he doesn't want to go to a team of your level.
[/list]

[b]SIMULATION[/b]
[list]
[*] Implemented substitutions of more than one player at the same time. It is now possible to request substitutions for all five outfield players at the same time.
[*] Fixed a bug that changed manual substitutions to automatic when starting a new match. Now, if you leave the substitutions on manual, it will save this setting for the next match.
[/list]

[b]OTHER ADJUSTMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that did not save the box office ticket prices correctly.
[*] Fixed bug that didn't allow individual training sessions from season 2 onwards.
[*] Fixed crash when consulting the history of scouted players.
[*] Revised the annotations of US ABL league matches, to increase a bit these annotations.
[*] Draft preview screen without free agents. Now all players shown belong to a college team.
[*] The college players appear in the "Search by filter" screen. If you play with a non-college team you can now find college players to keep track of in the future.
[*] Fixed visual bugs on multiple screens.
[*] Other small bugs fixed.
[/list]

We remind you that we have the [url=https://discord.gg/BQpgwRXSdE]IBM23 Discord server[/url] where you can comment your experience with the game, make suggestions, help us if you find any undetected bug, ask for technical support, comment everything related to workshop and mods and many more.

Thanks for your support, Managers!

notes.title: IBM23 Hotfix 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hello managers,

First of all, thank you very much for your support in the [b]International Basketball Manager 23[/b] launch which happened last week. We are very happy for the reception it had throughout the basketball community and this undoubtedly motivates us to continue working hard and together to manage this project as far away as possible.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2098130/International_Basketball_Manager_23/

This first update has been fast, and we have solved most of the serious issues that we have detected since the launch of the game:

[list]
[*]Fixed the block that didn’t allow it to advance in the calendar at the end of the season.
[*]Fixed the block during season change in career mode when changing teams.
[*]Fixed the block during season change due to transfers between AI teams.
[*]The memory used has been optimized primarily for mobile devices.
[*]Other bugs were fixed.
[/list]
Before Christmas we will make the first major update of the game fixing minor issues and adding or modifying functionalities taking into account your suggestions.

We remind you that we have enabled the [b][url=https://discord.gg/BQpgwRXSdE]IBM23 Discord server[/url][/b] where you can comment on your experience with the game, make suggestions and help us if you find any undetected bugs. There are many active managers in the channel and the community is growing.

We will continue working to improve the game with your help, so see you at IBM23.
